contracts.evidence: Closed-Beta age>=16, email verification, onboarding/account gating, HttpOnly sessions, revocation and device-session management are merged in WellFit-now. Graphical and Buddy surfaces may consume identity but do not own authentication authority.
Server flow attempt->evidence->admin review->completion->ledger->wallet exists. Buddy-specific AR/evidence events are not accepted end-to-end.

Server-authoritative internal ledger/wallet and Buddy spend exist with replay/idempotency/audit protections. WFXP versus WFP/XP semantics require explicit owner-reviewed migration; no token/real-money authority is active.

WellFit-now owns server-authoritative Buddy projections/actions and general technical app integration. WellFit-Buddy owns Buddy behavior/presentation/animation and Buddy-specific AR/camera events. Existing Unity Buddy AR code is still physically in WellFit-now; migration/event-schema/device acceptance remain open.

Worldwide published mission locations, geo-cell search, Haversine checks and safety-review fingerprints exist in WellFit-now. Buddy-specific sensor/location evidence contracts and real-device privacy validation are not accepted.

rules: Every cross-repository API, event, identifier or shared state must have a stable contract ID before acceptance.
Changing a contract requires impact review of all consumers.
Server-authoritative reward, mission and anti-cheat decisions remain in the technical WellFit-now domain.
WellFit-Buddy owns Buddy-specific behavior/presentation/AR, not the whole general technical mobile application.
A contract may be centralized before source code is physically migrated during convergence.
PARTIAL means a real implementation exists but at least one consumer, migration, semantic decision or integration acceptance remains open.
